div.head: Had 9
div.ab: 7 to hadbote, þær sambryce wurðe, bete man georne be þam þe seo dæd sy.
Et ad ordinis infracturam de pace digne componatur secundum factum.
And to hadbote, þar sambryce wyrðe, bete man georne be ðam þe seo dǽd sy.
And to hadbote, þær sambryce wurðe, bete man georne be ðam þe seo dæd sy.
And in compensation for [an offence against a man in] orders, if there occur [only] a half breach, one is to compensate eagerly in proportion to the deed.
And as compensation for one in orders if a partial violation occurs, the perpetrator must diligently make amends according to the deed.
Und wo halbe [nicht tödtliche] Verletzung eintritt, büsse man als Klerusbusse willig, je nachdem die That ist.
And where half [non-fatal] injury occurs, let one pay compensation for orders earnestly, according to what the deed is.
div.note: O reads ‘se brice’. Perhaps the Quadripartitus read ‘som’ for ‘sam-’ (hence ‘de pace’).
i.e. if no fatal injury is inflicted
a partial violation: That is, if the victim is only injured but not killed.
